Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::queryLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): LoanTerm {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(term|term.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:

		LoanTerm.allInstance()->exists(term|term.ItemID = itemid)
	postcondition:
		let loanTerm: LoanTerm in
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(loanTerm) and
		result = loanTerm
